data.text: Cancelled: superseded. 0.5.0 shipped 2026-09-18 and 0.6.0, 0.7.0, 0.8.0 followed; what this task asked of a release (teammate path first, no velocity in the description, a second person quoting a decision) moved into those releases and into Probe B. Its open criterion - a person who is not the author reaching a decision in 10 minutes - is still untested and belongs to KAD-4 (concierge pilots).
